rulings.answer: No. Cards that don't have levels can't be digivolved from, and you can't digivolve into this card. (Other than through special digivolutions.)
rulings.question: This card doesn't have a level. Can I still digivolve into it and into other cards?

rulings.answer: This is a specific rule that allows you to include up to 50 copies of cards with this card's card number in your deck.
rulings.question: What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly?  (*This card's "You can include up to 50 copies of cards with this card's card number in your deck" has been changed to "(Rule) You can include up to 50 copies of cards with this card's card number in your deck")

rulings.answer: The inherent rule is that you can have up to 50 of these cards in your deck.
